session: stage_tile(bytes) -> ContentDigest (sha256; one body <= limits.max_entry_bytes entry_too_large, all <= MAX_STAGED_BYTES 1 GiB total_too_large, same bytes once); tile_bytes(digest) (staged first, else hash-verified source read); render_assets() = every raster+mask tile body the current revision references, keyed by sha256 (render-ready for viewers); staged_bytes(); a submit whose successor references a tile neither in the source manifest nor staged is refused missing_asset before publication; LazyAssets serves staged bodies to save/checkpoint; on save, tiles of the old source the document no longer references (replaced by pixel edits) are retained in the staged set (bounded) so undo/redo after a save still commits; resident_bytes includes staged bytes; DESCRIPTOR staged_tiles
